messages:
Anna (Support): customer 'LumenPay' opened a ticket — high 5xx rate and p95 timeouts on hosted API since ~09:10 UTC. They report repeated 504s and intermittent 502s.
chris (Eng-Runtime): can you paste a sample request id and approximate q depth when it happens?
Anna (Support): sample req_id: req_2026-03-18_9-10-4123, tenant lumenpay-prod. They saw p95 jump from 200ms to ~12s. Dashboard shows continuous-batcher backlog and queue_depth hit 100 (per-tenant soft limit).
mike (Eng-SRE): saw alert from oncall-bot about queue_depth=100 on host pool gpupool-a. cpu/gpu util fine, but dequeue rate stalled.
Anna (Support): user included logs: "batcher: enqueue ok, kvcache miss, waiting for slot, timeout after 10s -> 504"
chris (Eng-Runtime): possible reason: an accumulation of long-sequence requests created blocking in the batching pipeline, causing tail latency spike and then soft-throttle kicking in. Are they using long_seq_mode?
Anna (Support): they said some calls are long (history + embeddings) but normal usage mostly short. Spike coincided with a data-migration job we suspect.
mike (Eng-SRE): quick mitigation: increase dequeue concurrency for that tenant or route to a fallback model with smaller kv cache. Also temporarily bump queue_depth limit for lumenpay-prod. I'll run a controlled bump and monitor.
chris (Eng-Runtime): also enable prefix KV caching for repeated prefixes and turn on async-dequeue option on the gateway to avoid head-of-line blocking.
Anna (Support): rolling change request: mike to bump tenant queue_depth to 150 for 10m, chris to enable async-dequeue + enable fallback routing to gpt-small for tenants exceeding 120 queued. I'll update customer.
mike (Eng-SRE): applied bump on gpupool-a for tenant lumenpay-prod -> queue_depth set to 150, watch metrics. :eyes:
oncall-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: queue_depth returned to 42 for tenant lumenpay-prod on gpupool-a at 09:12:03 UTC
Anna (Support): customer confirms errors dropped after 09:13, p95 back to ~220ms. They want postmortem and recommended hard limits.
chris (Eng-Runtime): next steps: add a guard that detects sustained kvcache miss patterns per-tenant and triggers proactive routing to burst pool or fallback quantized model. Create RFC with proposed thresholds (queue>120 for >30s). I'll draft.
mike (Eng-SRE): I'll add runbook step: immediate actions and a safe automated emergency bump policy with cooldown. Also capture trace for req_2026-03-18_9-10-4123 for further root cause.
Anna (Support): creating support ticket and will attach timeline + actions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
chris (Eng-Runtime): noting for follow-up: investigate why dequeue stalled while GPU utilization low — kernel-level stall or mutex contention in batcher.
mike (Eng-SRE): scheduling a short post-incident sync in #eng-oncall at 14:00 UTC.
Anna (Support): closing thread for now, will add postmortem link when ready.
